description: Defines error codes, enums, and classes related to QUIC protocol error handling, including stream errors, transport errors, HTTP/3 errors, and QPACK errors.

classes.name: QuicResetStreamError
classes.description: Represents a reason for resetting a stream with internal and IETF application error codes.

methods.name: FromInternal
methods.description: Creates a QuicResetStreamError from a QuicRstStreamErrorCode.

methods.name: FromIetf
methods.description: Creates a QuicResetStreamError from an IETF error code or specific error enums.

methods.name: NoError
methods.description: Returns a QuicResetStreamError representing no error.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Checks if the error object holds no error.
